title: Clicking blank canvas next to a label does not select its arrow
goal: An arrow with a label on it can be selected by clicking empty space beside the label: for a sentence, anything within about a finger width past the end of the label counts as a click on the arrow, so you pick up an arrow when you meant to click the button underneath. Clicking should only select the arrow where the arrow or its label actually is.
notes: Found on 2026-09-05 while fixing the caption drop. Layer.contains(canvasPoint:zoom:) hit-tests the caption with AnnotationContent.estimatedCaptionSize, which for a 25 character caption is 408pt wide against a measured 245: 163pt of blank canvas past the far edge answers to the arrow. The drop, the edge clamp and the pill GRAB now take a measured size (CanvasGrab.captionPillRect(of:captionPillSize:)); this one was left because it needs a measurement threaded through Document.hitTest/hitTestPath and every caller, since PhotonzCore cannot lay out type. Options: a captionPillSize closure on hitTest, or caching the measured pill on the layer at commit time.
acceptance: Clicking blank picture more than a few points past the end of an arrow label selects whatever is under the pointer, not the arrow
Clicking anywhere on the label itself still selects the arrow
A scripted walk clicks just past a long label and the log shows nothing selected

log.note: Reproduced before building: with the app handing hit-testing no measurement, a scripted click 40pt past the far edge of a 25 character label came back with the Arrow selected (Scripts/playtest/label-hit-box-walk.json).

Adversarial review of the two options in notes. Caching the measured pill ON the layer was rejected: it puts a rendering measurement in a pure, Codable model, and it goes stale on every font size, caption and release change, so every one of those paths would have to remember to refresh it. Threading a measurer through is the shorter, honest version: one closure type, default nil everywhere, so nothing that does not care changes.

Shipped: CaptionPillSizing in PhotonzCore (a (AnnotationContent) -> CGSize? the app fills in), taken by Layer.contains, PhotonzDocument.hitTest/hitTestPath and selectionTarget/extendTarget/descendTarget. The app hands all three canvas gestures CanvasNSView.captionPillSizing, which measures through CaptionMetrics. Current is untouched: arrow captions are a next-only flag, so hasCaption is never true there.

Verified: the whole suite green at 3945 tests, six of them the new AnnotationCaptionHitTests; the walk now reads selection [] past the label, ['Arrow'] on the label and on the shaft. Measuring costs 21.7us per caption (CaptionCostTests pins a 200us ceiling), so a click on a document with twenty labels stays under half a millisecond.
Audit: queue/audits/2026-09-06-label-hit-box.json with two real window captures.

Hit-testing now takes a measured caption pill (CaptionPillSizing through Layer.contains, PhotonzDocument.hitTest and the three group targets; the app fills it in via CaptionMetrics). Verified by reproducing first with the measurement withheld, then Scripts/playtest/label-hit-box-walk.json reading no selection 40pt past a sentence label and the Arrow on the label and shaft. Suite green at 3945. Audit: queue/audits/2026-09-06-label-hit-box.json
